g.text: OneNote carrying an embedded HTA/script/PE payload
• Pivot the extracted URLs/domains in VirusTotal, URLhaus and your passive DNS. Pull the staged
payload in an isolated VM, not on a host.
• Decode the PowerShell: base64 -d the -enc blob, then deobfuscate the download cradle to
• OneNote embedded payload(s): carve them with onedump.py (Didier Stevens), hash each dropped
file and analyse separately. Watch for ONENOTE.EXE spawning MSHTA/powershell/cmd in a sandbox.
• Cross-reference the SHA256 against MalwareBazaar / your internal corpus before writing it up -
you may already have the family and C2.
